description: Travel to Old time :Close to Notre Dame de Paris, charming and very functional apartment on the ground floor of an old 12th century building. Equipped with air conditioners, comfortable and quiet, close to shops, restaurants, metro, bus ... This apartment is perfect for 8-10 people who wish to immerse themselves in the rich and old history of Paris.The spaceCapacity of accomodating 10 people :Refurbished apartment located 2 steps from Notre Dame de Paris and Boulevard Saint Germain. Functional, comfortable, equipped with air conditioners and well-appointed, the apartment is suitable for 8 - 10 persons. It consists of: - Bedroom 1: 1 double bed (140 x 190 cm) and 2 single beds (90 x 190 cm) (with bathroom and wc) - Bedroom 2: 1 double bed (140 x 190 cm) - Bedroom 3: 1 double bed (140 x 190 cm) - Living room transformed into 4th bedroom: 1 high quality convertible sofa for 2 people (140 x 190 cm) - 2 bathrooms: showers with 2 hairdryers - 2 toilets - Well-equipped kitchen: fridge, microwave, toaster, kettle, coffee maker, dishes, utensils - Iron - washing machine - Sheets and towels provided - Smoke detector - TV, unlimited WiFi - Ecological heating system: aerothermal heat pump - Air conditioner - Dual flow VMC air exchange system that improves the quality of the incoming airGuest accessThe apartement is 100% for guests.Other things to noteYou can drop off your things from 11 am but the apartment will be ready from 4h pm. Ideal departure is before 11am but I remain flexible to find better solutions for you.- Please do not make noise and respect the neighbors (they are very sensitive to noise).- Please do not smoke in the apartment- Pets are not allowed (as there are people who are allergic to dogs, cats ...)
